description: This file defines the class `SugarDateTime`, which extends PHP's built-in `DateTime` class to add custom date and time handling functionalities, including parsing, formatting, and various date calculations tailored for the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: A subclass of PHP's DateTime with additional methods and properties for SuiteCRM's date handling needs.

methods.name: createFromFormat
methods.description: Static method to create a SugarDateTime object from a specified format and time string, with support for fallback parsing.

methods.name: parse_utc_date_time
methods.description: Static method to create a SugarDateTime object from an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getHashList
methods.description: Static method to generate a list of time slots for calendar views, based on start and end times.

methods.name: get_day_begin
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object representing the start of the specified day.

methods.name: get_day_end
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object representing the end of the specified day.

methods.name: get_year_begin
methods.description: Returns a new SugarDateTime object representing the start of the specified year.
